author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam unboxes three more marvelous mailbag packages that arrived while he was recently traveling, including a beautiful watch movement and a delightful desk calendar in the form of a puzzle. Adam attempts to solve the puzzle in real-time before taking a look at the final package: the complete filmography of Stanley Kubrick restored in 4K and released by The Criterion Collection!

Umbra 3D puzzle calendar: https://amzn.to/4ySgOgC
The Complete Kubrick Criterion Collection: https://amzn.to/4yYq9n1

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
